objective: Make how the grill is conducted explicit and recorded via three modes so the result's fidelity is traceable.
non_goals: No per-entry structured grill object; notes stay a flat array
No new gate forcing a specific mode by tier
No synchronous blocking added to headless runs beyond the existing blocked state

invariants: Existing contracts stay valid after migrating grill to the object form
check.py CLI exit codes stay 0 for valid, 1 for invalid, 2 for usage or load errors, and the default run does no network or git access
project.rollback: Revert the commit; grill returns to a flat array and contracts validate under the prior rules.

risk.rationale: Changes the portable grill schema (array to object) and adds a mode enum every downstream project follows.

notes: User proposed grill modes and deferred the two open choices (schema shape, default) with 'pars dessus'; proceeded on the recommended defaults: grill becomes {mode, notes} and mode is required when grill is present.

Grounded the taxonomy in the IETF Human Escalation Mechanism (HEM) draft: interactive maps to pre-action clarification that blocks; irreversible or protected gaps block in every mode; interactive presents options neutrally.
Mix is not a fourth mode: explore-first and research-when-knowable are common; the mode only picks the terminal action for a residual user-only gap.
Pre-mortem: modes could re-introduce the structured grill object Fable rejected; mitigated by adding only a single mode enum while notes stay a flat array.

acceptance.criterion: The test suite passes and the example and shipped contracts still validate after the schema migration.
The grill object with a known mode and non-empty unique notes is accepted, and malformed grills are rejected.

execution.rationale: The checker, skill, docs, example, and tests share the same files and must land in one order, so the lots run as a dependency chain.

tasks.outcome: Validate the grill object with mode and notes in check.py.
Define the three modes in the skill, README, and AGENTS.md.
Migrate the example and grill-step contract to the object form and cover the modes with tests.
